sections.markdown:
## B — Audience, level and prerequisites: night driving, driving situations, emergencies, vehicle failures and crashes
Audience: first-time New Jersey Class D applicants, including teen drivers who have little night or emergency experience.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the night stopping distances are exact-figure items worth memorizing [A01], and the shoulder and warning-device rules are classic emergency scenarios [A06].
Level: mostly scenario judgment (what to do when something fails) with a handful of exact figures; moderate load because several emergencies have opposite brake rules.
Prerequisites: the following-distance, skid and winter braking pages of the first defensive driving section.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
